items.title: Urban sketches
items.description: A small set of street and architecture studies from the same roll.

images.description: Corner facade in late afternoon light; long shadows across the pavement.
Narrow alley with a single strong highlight on brickwork.
Wide view of the crossing before the crowds arrived.

items.title: Coast morning
items.description: Calm water and low tide textures shot within an hour of sunrise.

images.description: First light on wet sand; cool blues with a thin band of warmth.
Breakers reduced to soft lines on a long exposure feel.
Gulls and distance; negative space kept deliberately high.

items.title: Night series
items.description: Hand-held available light; emphasis on colour cast and isolation.

images.description: Neon spill on wet asphalt; primary colours separated cleanly.
Window grid repeating; one lit rectangle breaks the rhythm.
Deep shadow with a single readable silhouette at the frame edge.

items.title: Trail and tide
items.description: Seven frames from coastal paths and quiet inland trails.

images.description: Low horizon; sky takes two-thirds of the frame.
Footprints leading out of frame toward the waterline.
Wind-leaned grass in the foreground, cliffs softened by haze.
Tide pool geometry; dark rock rimmed with white salt.
Single figure small against a wide grey sea.
Warm side light on pebbles; cool fill from open sky.
Last usable light before the path disappears into shadow.

items.title: Industrial edges
items.description: Four studies of metal, glass, and repeating structure.

images.description: Corrugated wall catching a narrow band of sun.
Reflection fractured in warehouse windows.
Pipes and valves read as abstract curves.
Loading bay in shade; one door held open.

items.title: Green and grey
items.description: Nine images mixing vegetation, overcast sky, and wet surfaces.

images.description: Moss-heavy stone wall after rain.
Tree canopy closing over a narrow road.
Field edge; hedgerow as a dark horizontal.
Puddle mirror breaking the symmetry of the path.
Fog lifting; distant hills barely separated from sky.
Ferns in shade with one blade catching a highlight.
Wet bark texture filling the frame.
Overcast portrait of place: bench, path, empty middle.
Wide cloud deck with a sliver of brighter band near zenith.

items.title: Two frames
items.description: A minimal pair kept deliberately short.

images.description: Interior corner; warm lamp against cool ambient.
Street geometry simplified to three tones.

items.title: Scan strip notes
items.description: Six frames from film scans—edges, numbers, and small imperfections left visible.

images.description: Perforation edge visible; subject shifted off-centre.
Soft grain in mid-tones; contrast held low.
Highlights lifted slightly; shadow detail retained.
Colour cast left uncorrected for mood.
Frame within frame; doorway as natural crop.
Last frame on the strip; slight light leak at one edge.
